ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes; dark, contiguous geometric banding along the trailing edges; dense cluster of dark, roughly circular mottling on the right lobe; large, irregular dark patch originating at the median notch and extending into the lower-left quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 120 degrees; notch depth constitutes approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the fluke in 2D projection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge; right lobe shows greater peak-to-valley pixel variance than the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convexity along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of approximately 15-20 distinct, dark, roughly circular pixel groups (mottling or barnacle scars) concentrated on the mid-to-outer portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, near-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe; irregular, ragged pixel boundaries at the extreme tips of both lobes indicative of minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical dark pigmentation focal point located at the base of the right lobe near the peduncle attachment.
